notes: Host is an M3 Taurus member (~3.4 Myr, XEST/XMM-Newton survey source) with a known circumstellar disk (SMA-detected, Akeson et al. 2019). KOINTREAU-2b confirmed bound via common proper motion with Gaia astrometry (log Bayes factor ~25.1); interpreted as a young star obscured by its own edge-on disk rather than a substellar object.
